title: Aphelion admin history and banner wrap-up
content:
Aphelion ended the night with a steadier curation workflow and a cleaner shell. The options page now keeps an action history, the top banners across the public/admin/highlights surfaces line up more consistently, and the hover timing was pulled back after a flashier delay proved less comfortable in practice.

What worked:

  • Action history on Admin: saves, adds, renames, deletes, and series/attribute assignments now leave a local audit trail so the curation work is easier to resume.
  • Header alignment: Highlights, Admin, Public, Back, and Options were reorganized so the page shells feel like one system instead of several unrelated layouts.
  • Workflow polish: the curation page stayed focused on the working image and metadata surface instead of spreading into more panels than necessary.

What we learned:

  • The 400ms hover experiment was too floaty: it made the page feel like it was flashing during block selection, so it was returned to the calmer 250ms settle.
  • A blank-square loading swap was unnecessary for now: the existing loading treatment was the safer choice, so that test was backed out before it became part of the public flow.

The next pass can stay focused on curation and layout details; the bookkeeping is now in better shape for picking up later.
